notes.title: Update from 08.20.2016
notes.content:
Update from 08.20.2016

- Fixed fonts, better font placement
- Game now defaults to fullscreen mode
- Disabled option that allowed for breaking game speed
- Better default contrast value
- Aborigine and colonist leaders now more prominent on the mini-map.

notes.title: Important update of 28 October
notes.content:
Important update of 28 October.

Here is a list of changes, important ones first.
1. Added mode: hardcore difficulty.
2. Graphics. Made smooth movement of all beings.
3. Fixed a bug: soldiers could fight before his creation.
4. Fixed a bug: armourer sometimes could not forge.
5. Added a panic mode for player with low health.
6. Fixed bug with failure of land checking for construction.
7. Fixed a bug, some characters could not drop more than 100 resources, so the resources are disappearing.
8. Fixed a bug in the AI work of the woodcutter.
9. Added more detailed messages about the impossibility of construction.
10. Slightly increased the size of the game map.
11. A lot of fixes and AI tuning.
12. [!!] Old game saves can not work with this new version, you must start a new game.


Важное обновление от 28 октября.

Вот список изменений, важные вначале.
1. Добавлен режим хардкорной сложности.
2. Графика, сделано плавное перемещение всех существ.
3. Исправлен баг, солдаты могли сражаться до своего создания.
4. Исправлен баг, оружейник иногда не мог ковать сабли.
5. Добавлен режим паники у игрока при низком здоровье.
6. Исправлен баг с несрабатыванием проверки земли под строительство.
7. Исправлен баг, некоторые персонажи не сбрасывали ресурсы более 100, тем самым ресурсы исчезали.
8. Исправлен баг, ошибка в работе дровосека колонистов.
9. Добавлены более детальные сообщения о невозможности строительства.
10. Немного увеличен размер игровой карты.
11. Много исправлений и настройки ИИ.
12. [!!] Старые сэйвы не могут работать с новой версией, необходимо начать новую игру.

notes.title: Code update and the technical parameters of the engine
notes.content:
Code update and the technical parameters of the engine.

1. Fixed the problem: some gui content disappearing when walking.
2. The game now takes about 30% less memory.
3. Approximately 2 times accelerated the generation of a new game.
4. The game AI accelerated by 15% and 20% increase in FPS when rendering graphics.
5. 2 times reduced the size of game saves on disk.

Important. Old game saves (earlier than 15.october.2015) may stop work correctly, so I highly recommend to start a new game.

notes.title: The game was updated, couple dozen bugs and problems corrected.
notes.content:
The game was updated, couple dozen bugs and problems corrected. Slightly corrected balance.
Here is a list of changes.

1. Fixed critical bug that instantly killed player in caves after reload.
2. Fixed bug that made woodcutter give up work for no apparent reason.
3. Fixed bug that made ship option "come aboard" not to appear.
4. Added "Reset to default" option to settings.
5. Purser now counts resources three times faster.
6. Now aboriginals attack sooner, when they see enemy.
7. Lack of resources reports now are noticeably and correctly added to log.
8. Opened chest now has its own sprite.
9. Added "Take everything" option to item context menu .
10. Shipwright and boatswain now work a bit faster.
11. Made several small balance corrections.
12. Fixed some in game texts.
13. A lot of other minor fixes.
